review_note: B.13 exact radial opacity comparison; push on moving-muon branch + manual; contents:write; Python 3.12/numpy/scipy; unittest plus radial mass=10 run; commits JSON back to branch; guard enforces branch. Branch exists. Ensure write-back remains justified and exact source/profile provenance is recorded.

Vertex-preserving B.13/B.14-B.16 radial comparison; push/manual; contents:write; runs tests, mass=10 radial output, checks profile SHA; commits JSON. Strong source fingerprint check; branch guard. Preserve as distinct profile-specific audit; write scope should be minimized if archival can use artifacts.

Read-only global B.13 quadrature convergence; push/manual on moving-muon branch; 360-min timeout; four quadrature scans, B.16 same-grid closure assertions, uploads artifact for 90 days. No durable commit-back; contents:read appropriate. Does not validate complete physical axial limit.

Nine-case B.13/B.16 grid matrix plus aggregate; push/manual branch-guarded; contents:write/actions:read; each matrix job commits summaries, aggregate commits report. Concurrency is matrix-safe only via rebase/retry. Heavy and expensive; verify output overwrite/commit races and retain distinction between convergence and physical acceptance.

B.13 radial/energy convergence scan; push/manual branch guard; contents:write; Python 3.12; compiles/runs scan, checks profile SHA and 3 grids, asserts production outputs unchanged, commits JSON. Distinct from angular/path quadrature audit; review whether outputs should be artifacts or committed.

Compact summary job waits for three 0.1/1/10 MeV full outputs, then writes summaries back; push/manual branch guard; contents:write. It does not itself run transport or validate the physical gate. Manual dispatch can be a no-op if inputs absent; document readiness semantics.

Full 0.1/1/10 MeV B.13 source+opacity transport on fixed vertex-preserving profile; tests bookkeeping, verifies profile SHA and B.16 closure, asserts production axial outputs unchanged, commits results. contents:write, long run. Critical distinction: three-mass output and B.16 closure do not equal Fig.7 10 MeV physical acceptance.

10 MeV local B.13 kernel quadrature convergence; tests thermal rates and runs high-order audit; writes JSON back; branch guard and production-output diff. Local kernel only, not radial transport; contents:write should be reviewed for necessity.

Matrix local-kernel convergence at 0.1 and 1 MeV; push/manual branch guard; contents:write; commits per-mass outputs. Similar code to single-mass local audit but distinct mass coverage; no explicit git-diff check for empty staging before commit may create empty-commit failure if output unchanged.

Global B.13 convergence matrix for 0.1 and 1 MeV with 9 scans per mass; push/manual branch guard; contents:write; tests, profile SHA, B.16 closure and production-output isolation, commits outputs. Very expensive (240 min); no explicit staged-diff guard before git commit, so unchanged output can cause an empty-commit failure.

B.14 nonrelativistic-muon source-weighted velocity diagnostic; push/manual on moving-muon branch; contents:write; tests, physical bounds and shell-fraction closure; commits JSON. Verify the B.16 comparison input provenance and keep this approximation diagnostic separate from exact B.13 rates.

Independent B.1 thin-source integral; branch push/manual; contents:write; tests radial/energy/tail convergence, channel closure, energy-variable equivalence and production isolation; commits output. Checkout is hard-coded to branch name rather than github.sha, weakening event-SHA reproducibility; pin to triggering SHA if workflow is retained.

64,000-point local B.6-B.10/B.14-B.19 kernel audit; branch push/manual; contents:write; 90-min timeout; extensive residual and angular convergence assertions, finite-value checks, production isolation; commits JSON. This is local-kernel evidence, not global transport.

Direction-resolved B.2 escape audit for 8-15 km sources; tests geometry, high angular/path/radial orders, verifies production isolation, commits JSON. contents:write; branch guard. Keep separate source-shell scope; no explicit profile fingerprint assertion in this workflow.

Generic-named directional escape workflow executes the same script and writes the same 8-15km JSON as b16-directional-escape-8-15.yml, but omits --energy-offset 1000 and has different path filters. Potential same-path output collision and differing default energy convention; clarify whether intentional, then rename/separate output or consolidate only after run-history review.

B.16 10 MeV emission-radius and escape-probability audit; tests shell/opacity matrices, runs 40x100x16x32 grid and commits JSON; production-output isolation. contents:write. No explicit profile SHA assertion in workflow; check script output embeds profile provenance.

High-order 10 MeV phase-space decomposition (200 radial, 640 opacity, 200 energy, 32 angular, 64 path); extensive closure, normalization and marginal reconstruction assertions; commits JSON. contents:write; 180-min. Strong bookkeeping gates but still B.16 vector diagnostic, not axial acceptance.

Flavor-resolved fixed-omega vs path-redshift comparison at 10 MeV; regression tests and production-output isolation; commits JSON with contents:write. Ensure flavor/energy conventions and profile identity remain in output; no explicit hash assertion here.

10 MeV B.16 Fig.7 vector benchmark on pinned vertex-preserving profile; tests global integral, profile SHA assertion and production-output isolation; commits JSON. contents:write; do not interpret as axial-current acceptance.

B.16 global vector luminosity/redshift audit for 0.1,1,10 MeV; tests global integral and commits JSON; contents:write; production outputs guarded. Unlike the single 10 MeV vertex-preserving run, this uses default profile inputs; compare exact input fingerprint and energy convention before combining results.

High-order B.16 independent source/opacity grid scan at 0.1/1/10 MeV; 200 radial/energy, 640 opacity, 32 angular, 64 path; validates grid hashes, profile SHA and method label; commits per-mass outputs. contents:write; 180-min matrix. Explicitly labels B.14 nonrelativistic-muon/no-recoil Compton method; do not confuse with exact B.13.

Three-mass independent-grid quadrature variation using prior high-order outputs; validates fixed source/opacity grids, energy-grid changes, finite diagnostics and four variations. contents:write; matrix; output commit. Depends on baseline artifacts already present in repository; verify that baselines are current and match source commit before dispatch.

Inner 8-12 km muon-neutrino negative-branch sensitivity at 10 MeV; runs diagnostic and protects production outputs; commits JSON and Markdown. contents:write. No explicit unittest, profile SHA check or finite-value validation in YAML; confirm those in script/output before relying on result.

Analytic inner-path channel×shell×direction audit at 10 MeV; runs tests, direct path order 256 vs legacy 32, energy-offset 1000, production isolation; commits JSON. contents:write. Generic profile path.

Vertex-preserving profile version of inner-path channel×shell×direction audit; adds exact profile SHA-256 assertion and writes a distinct output JSON; tests same analytic path integration. contents:write. Correctly separates profile-specific result from generic-profile output.
